# Get Bundle (Reels & Digital Products Store)
> Premier Curated Digital Marketplace for 9:16 Viral Reels Bundles, Templates, and Short-Form Creator Video Assets.

## Brand Entity Information
- **Brand Name:** Get Bundle
- **Entity Type:** Digital Marketplace & Content Production Platform for Creators & Agencies
- **Primary Product:** Curated high-retention 9:16 vertical MP4 reels bundles (1080x1920 HD/4K) across 20+ viral niches.
- **Operating Currency:** INR (₹), with direct personal fulfillment via UPI, GPay, PhonePe, Paytm, and Cards.
- **Official Contact Channel:** Instagram Direct Message @giveme_8 (https://instagram.com/giveme_8 or https://ig.me/m/giveme_8)
- **Support Email:** Support@betterbundle.in
- **Delivery Speed:** Instant delivery under 15 minutes via private Google Drive folders protected by verified server-side passwords.
- **Commercial Usage Rights:** Full PLR & MRR posting, editing, and commercial monetization rights on Instagram, YouTube Shorts, Facebook Reels, and TikTok.
